The four cadence criteria are the scheme’s "Criteria for awarding marks at cadence points" lines, each 12 over the four cadences (the per-cadence table A-D prints the same lines at 1 x 3 and 3). The two "Up to 3 marks for quality ... (3 x 4)" lines carry no bands and sit on 0-12. The Section B general points (scheme p6) are carried on all three questions. The 2025 Ordinary scheme prints NO table of given or accepted chords for Q4-Q6, so there is no scheme crop.
